summary.en: Pakistan-linked actors are again implicated in violent incidents, with arrests of PTI leaders tied to a Radio Pakistan attack and two suspects detained for a railway-track blast in Rajasthan that killed two people. In Balochistan a separatist-claimed drone strike killed six Pakistani soldiers and a motorcycle bomb in Bara wounded two civilians, while a child was killed by a mortar shell explosion in Ghazni, Afghanistan. Pakistan showcased the Arrow‑1 strike drone with stealth features and possible Raad cruise missile linkages, and a border monitoring report documented inflows from Iran. The conflict recorded 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Pakistan-tilknyttede aktører er igjen involvert i voldelige hendelser, med pågripelser av PTI-ledere knyttet til et angrep på Radio Pakistan og to mistenkte som ble holdt i varetekt for en sprengning av en jernbanespor i Rajasthan som drepte to personer. I Balochistan drepte et droneram fra en separatist-påstand seks pakistanske soldater, og en motorsykkelbombe i Bara såret to sivile, mens et barn ble drept av en mortergranat-eksplosjon i Ghazni, Afghanistan. Pakistan viste frem Arrow‑1‑angrepsdronen med stealth-egenskaper og mulige Raad-kryssningsmissil-koblinger, og en grenseovervåkningsrapport dokumenterte innstrømninger fra Iran. Konflikten registrerte 1 794 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
